action.title: Identifies if a record is to be upserted (inserted or updated) or (hard) deleted.

key.title: This table stores attributes for users.
key.description:
Some users are from other Canvas instances (`id` column being > 10000000000000). Not all users are displayed in
users list on UI.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp that shows when a user was deleted at.

storage_quota.description: The storage quota for the users.

lti_context_id.description: UUID of the Canvas context in LTI standard. secondary ID for this context, could be used in API to identify resource as well.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the user was created in the Canvas system.

updated_at.description: Timestamp that shows the last time the record was updated.

workflow_state.description: Workflow status indicating the status of the user.

sortable_name.description: The name of the user that is should be used for sorting groups of users, such as in the gradebook. Format: "lastname, firstname".

avatar_image_url.description: If avatars are enabled, this field will be included and contain a url to retrieve the user's avatar.

avatar_image_source.description: The source of a user avatar image.

avatar_image_updated_at.description: Timestamp that shows the last time the avatar image was updated.

short_name.description: A short name the user has selected, for use in conversations or other less formal places through the site.

last_logged_out.description: The last time the user explicitly logged out of Canvas.

pronouns.description: stores a list of preferred gender pronouns i.e.: she/her; he/him; they/them.

merged_into_user_id.description: If this user was merged into another one, this is the foreign key to that other user.

locale.description: The user's locale. This is an optional field and may not be entered by the user.

name.description: The name of the user ("firstname lastname" format).

time_zone.description: This field is only returned in certain API calls, and will return the IANA time zone name of the user's preferred timezone.

school_name.description: Used in Trial Versions of Canvas, the school the user is associated with.

school_position.description: Used in Trial Versions of Canvas, the position the user has at the school. E.g. Admin

public.description: Used in Trial Versions of Canvas, the type of school the user is associated with.
